newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares index edges higher in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares index edges higher in busy trade.

text.p: Shares on the Saudi stock market ended the week to Thursday firmer in brisk trade focused on service sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Sunday.
The index ended on Thursday at 165.68 points up from 163.35 points a week earlier.
Of the 62 companies traded, 50 rose, 9 fell and three were unchanged.
Services sector stocks continued to dominate, accounting for 54 percent of volume which BFA put at about 13 million shares worth 1.47 billion riyals ($392 million).
Tihama was the major gainer in the week with the stock price ending 15.2 percent higher at 76 riyals from 66 riyals the pevious week.
The biggest loser was Tabuk Electricity which lost 27.3 percent to 93 riyals from 128 riyals last week.
